description: This file contains data models and request classes related to asset management in a backend system. It defines record types, request payloads for creating, updating, deleting, and querying assets, and includes validation logic for input consistency.

classes.name: CreateAssetRequest
classes.description: Payload model for creating a new asset, with validation logic for required fields and conditional rules.

classes.name: UpdateAssetRequest
classes.description: Payload model for updating an existing asset, including validation for conditional requirements.

classes.name: DeleteAssetRequest
classes.description: Payload model for soft-deleting an asset, capturing audit fields.

classes.name: QueryAssetsRequest
classes.description: Model defining optional filter parameters for searching assets.

classes.name: AssetDto
classes.description: Data transfer object representing a persisted asset record, mapping to a database table.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Implements custom validation logic for CreateAssetRequest and UpdateAssetRequest, enforcing conditional fields based on other input values.
